checks.name: J-Link enumeration
checks.evidence: J-Link serial 760224787 enumerated with VTref 3.300 V.

checks.name: minimal flash read
checks.evidence: Four words at flash address 0x00000000 were readable, showing an existing application.

checks.name: complete pre-flash backup
checks.evidence: A complete 512 KiB backup succeeded after power cycling. SHA-256: fd536fc1c517f2a450a94e2b652cca53a590313d6955e499e8d0febd9a282364.

checks.name: ICM-20948 identity and stream
checks.evidence: Diagnostic firmware was deliberately not flashed without a verified restore image.

checks.name: passive existing CDC UART observation
checks.evidence: J-Link serial 760224787 exposed COM6. A ten-second passive read at 115200 baud received one NUL byte only; it contained no readable startup line, ICM record, or telemetry frame.

checks.name: temporary ICM diagnostic programming
checks.evidence: Two target-specific J-Link attempts stopped before download with 'Failed to preserve target RAM @ 0x20000000-0x2001FFFF'. One attempt used the documented work-RAM initialization setting. The official Nordic nrfutil device programmer independently failed before programming because the SWD debug-port ID register was invalid. The flash vector remained equal to the verified original backup after all attempts.

safety_decision: Do not erase or flash the board until SWD stability is restored and a complete backup is verified.
non_claims: The external ICM power LED does not establish I2C communication.
No ICM WHO_AM_I value or telemetry record has been observed.
